outcomes.question: How many days do I have to get a refund on a monthly plan?
outcomes.answer: You have 14 days to get a refund on a monthly plan from the payment date. After 14 days, the payment is not refunded, but you can cancel the plan so you are not charged again.

outcomes.question: I cancel my yearly plan after 4 months. How much do I get back?
outcomes.answer: After 4 months of your annual plan, you will get back 8 months of the price, minus a 10% administration fee. This is according to the refund policy for annual plans, which states that refunds are given for the unused full months, minus the 10% fee after 30 days of purchase.

outcomes.question: How long until the refund shows on my card?
outcomes.answer: The refund will show up on your card in 5 to 10 business days, depending on your bank. This is the standard processing time for refunds.

outcomes.question: If I move to a cheaper plan, when does that happen?
outcomes.answer: If you move to a cheaper plan, the change takes effect at the end of the current billing period. You will continue to have the features of your current plan until then.

outcomes.question: Where do I download my invoices?
outcomes.answer: To download your invoices, go to Settings > Billing > Invoices and select the invoices you want to download as PDF.

outcomes.question: I forgot to enter my discount code when I paid last week. Can it still be applied?
outcomes.answer: Unfortunately, you cannot add a discount code to a payment that has already been made. If you forgot to use a code, contact Billing within 7 days of the payment.

outcomes.question: My renewal payment failed. What happens to my account?
outcomes.answer: If your renewal payment fails, your account will continue to work for up to 7 days. After that, it will move to the Free plan. No data will be deleted, and you can restore your plan by making a payment again.

outcomes.question: The bank verification window stays blank when I pay. What should I do?
outcomes.answer: If the bank verification window stays blank, turn off pop-up blockers and try again, or use another browser. If the payment still fails, try another card or PayPal, or open a ticket with the exact error message.

outcomes.question: I lost my phone and can't get my two-factor codes. How do I sign in?
outcomes.answer: You can sign in using one of the 10 backup codes you saved when you turned on 2FA. Each backup code works once. If you have no backup codes, you need to open a ticket, and support will verify your identity before turning 2FA off, which takes up to 2 business days.

outcomes.question: I think someone else is using my account. What should I do?
outcomes.answer:
To address potential unauthorized access to your account, you should:
1. Change your password immediately (Settings > Security > Change password).
2. Sign out of all devices by clicking 'Sign out of all devices' on the same page.
3. Enable two-factor authentication to add an extra layer of security.
4. If needed, open a ticket with the category Security, and the Security Team will assist you within 1 hour.
